title: Bitcoin - Unmasking Satoshi Nakamoto
summary: Barely Sociable presents a case that Bitcoin creator Satoshi Nakamoto is cryptographer Adam Back. It uses interview clips and circumstantial evidence, and also touches on the block size dispute.
why: HN commenters recommend it as a compelling, if not definitive, argument for Adam Back as Satoshi whenever the identity question comes up.

quote.text: painted quite a compelling story of why Adam Beck is Satoshi
